MakerDAO is a decentralized finance protocol that operates on the Ethereum blockchain. MakerDAO issues the DAI stablecoin through overcollateralized loans secured by crypto assets. MakerDAO is governed by holders of the MKR governance token.

Vesper is a yield aggregation protocol built on smart contracts. Vesper deposits user funds into vaults that run yield-generating strategies. Vesper automatically reinvests earned yield to compound returns for depositors.

Sushiswap is a decentralized exchange that uses an automated market maker model. Sushiswap was forked from the Uniswap codebase. Sushiswap is governed through its SUSHI token.

Pickle Jars are yield optimizer vaults offered by Pickle Finance. Pickle Jars accept deposits of liquidity provider tokens and deploy them into yield farming strategies. Pickle Jars automatically compound farming rewards for depositors.

Cetus Protocol is a decentralized exchange built on the Sui blockchain. Cetus Protocol uses concentrated liquidity market making so that liquidity providers can allocate capital within chosen price ranges. Cetus Protocol operates without centralized intermediaries and relies on smart contracts for trading.
